WORLD BOSSES:

  1. Implementing a barrier around the Golem Mk 2 platform that destroys projectiles. Forces players onto the charged floor to dance the electric slide.
  2. Random surges of lava during Megadestroyer to get players moving around the floor. Implementing "ice rays" that players have to aim at the Destroyer to make him non-invincible.
  3. Having Shadow Behemoth do his group aoe/wipe more often where players congregate and make portals tougher.

DUNGEONS:

  1. Create "gates" that won't open unless x% of monsters so far have been killed, but give much better rewards for doing so.
  2. Adopt a LFG system a la Rift where players join a dungeon group as a designated role (healer, tank, dps, support, etc.) while at the same time embracing dedicated healing since every class has the potential to heal.

WORLD BOSSES:
